tagline: Turn a vague UI ask into a concrete frontend spec, design tokens, and a Figma export schema
description: Frontend Design takes a one-line feature ask plus a brand reference and produces a paste-ready design spec, a W3C-shaped design-tokens JSON, and a Figma frame schema a designer can bulk-create. It nails down the component breakdown, states, and accessibility notes before a single line of UI code gets written. Use it when an engineer is staring at a blank Tailwind file or a designer needs a structured handoff.
capability_steps: Drafts a design-spec.md with layout, components, states, and a11y notes
Generates a tokens.json with HSL color ramps, spacing, radius, and typography
Emits a Figma frame schema for bulk-creating component states
Calls out missing states (loading, empty, error) before code is written
References WCAG 2.2 for focus order, ARIA roles, and contrast checks
trigger_phrases: build a UI spec for this feature
scaffold design tokens from our brand
try_phrases: I need a spec for a billing settings page in React + Tailwind
draft a frontend spec for a checkout flow, brand color is #3B82F6 and font is Inter
build tokens.json from our brand and a Figma schema I can hand to design
permissions: Read & write files in your workspace
Read a brand-reference JSON you supply
